column4: Keep low-risk travel, charged return teleports, pouches and run-energy gear. No combat armour completion. Do not assume teleport charges or shortcut access.
Separate respiratory-system/ranged or magic preparation from melee boss phases. Preserve demonbane and Slayer-task context; do not fill a switch with an unrelated raid inventory.
Keep the selected dragonfire protection package and anti-poison supplies; dragonbane and chosen attack style precede ordinary strength or accuracy ladders.
Keep Slayer-task eligibility and Karuulm travel protection. Brimstone/stone/granite boots or the verified diary waiver must be handled separately from offensive boot ranking.
Keep the guide's melee method and frost-related travel/supply requirements. Evaluate owned lower-tier melee gear within that method.
Preserve the fast slash switch used to sever the lure, even if the main weapon ranks higher. Keep access/travel requirements and magic-defence priorities.
Keep crush-oriented choices, venom protection and guide-specific support weapons. A higher generic stab/slash ranking is not a valid replacement.
Use a low-risk Wilderness branch with the selected combat method, spell/supply requirements and charged Wilderness weapons where applicable; never assume item protection on death.
Keep ranged capability and relevant God Wars protection. Separate Wilderness and God Wars variants where the source does; do not select a generic melee loadout.
Keep role-specific gear and supplied arrows/runes. Attacker, defender, collector and healer examples are not competing upgrade tiers.
Keep role and advanced-method context, movement priorities and supplied ammunition. Do not mix an advanced role inventory with an unrelated equipment example.

Preserve the selected spell/staff method and brother switches. Magic damage, adequate accuracy and defensive armour have different priorities; do not force a full magic set merely because the main attack is magic.

Require an appropriate gaze-protection shield, normally mirror shield or V's shield. Reject a defender or two-handed replacement that defeats that protection. Check Slayer-task and spell restrictions separately.
Keep ice/goldsmith gloves according to method, coal-bag access and run-energy/weight choices. Generic combat gloves are not substitutes.
Keep dragonfire protection, ranged ammunition compatibility and dragonbane choices. Do not equate a wyvern shield policy with ordinary dragonfire rules.
Keep the activity's attack-style recommendation and low-level equipment requirements; offer usable owned low-level alternatives rather than endgame-only donors.
Keep Wilderness risk and solo/group method explicit. Use method-compatible weapons and control supplies; do not inherit raid armour as the default.
Keep crush/demon/undead interactions, Salve suitability, Wilderness risk and charged weapon state. Do not stack incompatible offensive necklace/head assumptions.
Keep the selected melee/ranged method, demonbane context and spectral-shield utility switch separate from the normal off-hand. Preserve emergency supplies.
Keep room roles, Olm styles, Tekton/Vasa and other room-specific weapons, prep tools and shared switches. A room's first choice is not the whole raid's first choice.
Use CM-specific room, defence and inventory assumptions. Share safe equipment families with ordinary CoX only after matching the room/role.
Preserve Wilderness risk, disarming-related inventory strategy and the chosen ranged/melee method; generic best-DPS gear is not a safe default.
Keep low-risk ranged equipment and ammunition, protection/supplies and escape options.
Treat this as a Wilderness Prayer-training/travel setup, not a combat loadout. Preserve bones, low risk and the selected transport method.
Preserve Wilderness thieving, escape and low-risk gear; do not complete empty slots with raid equipment.
Require the ogre-bow family and matching ogre ammunition plus hunting supplies. Ordinary bows/arrows are not equivalent fallbacks.
Preserve kiting method, ranged ammunition and God Wars protection. Verify run-energy/sustain inventory rather than importing ToA supplies.
Keep stat-draining, quick-pool, dolo and team methods separate; enforce the weapon mechanic and planned spec/support roles.
Keep the selected magic method and Wilderness risk. Use a low-risk setup.
Keep Rex/Prime/Supreme roles and the selected solo or multi-king method. Do not replace three combat roles with one generic style loadout.
Keep the two-style switching package and demonbane interactions. An individually higher item may be worse if it adds unnecessary switches.
Use the local non-Wilderness method and appropriate magic/supplies; do not inherit Crazy Archaeologist's risk policy merely because names are similar.
Keep slash/demonbane and preparation-phase supplies. Compare sustained main weapons separately from special-attack choices.
Preserve God Wars protection, chosen target style and access supplies. Useful faction protection can outrank a higher raw combat bonus.
Preserve minigame tools, run-energy and method-specific utility. No combat fallback completion.
Preserve wave/boss switches and method-specific defensive/utility items. Keep full-set and ammo constraints; do not collapse all encounters into one DPS ordering.
Preserve approved icy-breath shields; ordinary antifire potions/anti-dragon shield are not interchangeable substitutes. Keep task/species and freezing distinctions.
Account for crush versus stab, fire-spell weakness, dragonbane and selected safespot/protection method. Its icy dragonfire is not the same protection rule as wyvern icy breath.
Keep melee tank and ranged/magic kiting methods separate, including God Wars protection, ammo and supply assumptions.
Keep Dharok/other full-set methods separate from ordinary melee or ranged. Preserve light/tracking and travel utilities rather than substituting by combat stats.
Use skilling outfit/tool/utility roles. Combat ranking and GE value do not determine the recommended outfit.
Preserve machete method, food/utility and any intentionally low chopping effectiveness; the highest-level tool is not automatically the correct recommendation.
Keep location-specific Wilderness risk and a valid dragonfire package. General melee defaults must not replace protection or low-risk choices.
Keep ranged/melee phase switches, Slayer-task requirements and rock-hammer/finishing capability. Slot alternatives must preserve the whole method.
Preserve outfit pieces, pickaxe, pouches and tool requirements; distinguish owned, unlock-dependent and minigame-provided supplies.
Preserve floor/shortcut access, trap tools and Hallowed equipment utility. Do not replace utility pieces with ordinary defence or weight rankings alone.
Keep the flower-clearing ranged option and main combat method. Required utility switches must survive fallback selection.
Keep this explicitly mode-specific and separate from ordinary Hespori. Verify the current source's mode/availability before recommending restricted equipment in normal worlds.
Keep tools for the selected rumour pool, transport and outfit utility. Do not present all activity tools as simultaneously mandatory.
Keep wave-management spells, ranged weapons, ammunition and defensive switches. Full inventory/supply strategy matters more than filling every slot by a universal score.
Keep demonbane, attack-style and solo/group/kiting method, plus God Wars protection and relevant poison supplies.
Keep phase-one/phase-two combat roles, task context and selected defence-reduction/switch method. Do not treat the two phases as interchangeable donors.
Keep Wilderness travel risk distinct from the boss arena, along with the guide's dragonfire/protection package and dragonbane options.
Choose the DPS or AFK/sustain method. Preserve magic defence versus magic-damage tradeoffs and Slayer-task headgear; a generic magic-accuracy helm is not automatically an improvement.
Preserve ranged/magic method, chinchompa or weapon/ammo requirements and God Wars protection. Ordinary melee gear is not a fallback.
Keep the actual Slayer task, required equipment and Wilderness risk. A blanket generic combat setup cannot cover every task.
Keep Wilderness risk, chosen safespot method and dragonfire/escape supplies where relevant.
Preserve Shayzien poison protection. Allow Slayer-head substitution only with the actual diary/reward unlock; ordinary CoX shamans are a separate context.
Preserve golembane and the encounter's accuracy/damage-window mechanics. A flat accuracy-weighted score can mis-rank gear here.
Keep barrage/burst, chinning and Hallowfell methods separate. Prayer efficiency, AoE, full-set and spell requirements take precedence over single-target accuracy rankings.
Keep species, chosen style, dragonbane and dragonfire protection. Generic dragon grouping must not erase spell weaknesses or protection assumptions.
Keep dragonfire protection and chosen dragonbane/magic/ranged method. Verify the lower-cost option against that method, not ToA weapon order.
Keep slash defence, each Moon's melee-style weakness and locally produced supplies. A strength-only upgrade can worsen survivability and overall performance.
Preserve team/method-specific ranged-melee switches, bolt compatibility and relevant protection/supply roles. Faction protection and face protection are distinct requirements.
Keep absorption/overload versus prayer methods and full-set assumptions, including HP-dependent methods. Do not combine their inventories automatically.
Keep ranged/magic phases, prayer-shield crossbow/bolt role and chosen method. Keep utility weapons separate from the main damage weapon.
Keep crush main damage, magic pillar role and support switches. Preserve solo-specific gear/supply assumptions rather than ordinary Nightmare defaults.
Keep fishing method, bait, rod/outfit and transport. No combat completion; distinguish processing ingredients from gear.
Keep bracelet/ether state, Wilderness weapon charges and risk choices. A depleted item is not a ready substitute and expensive gear should not be silently promoted.
Keep dragonfire, insulator/boot utility where the method calls for it, dragonbane and sustain assumptions. Offensive boots are not universally better.
Keep crush-oriented method, chosen special attacks and sustain. Budget melee fallbacks must retain the intended attack style.
Keep Wilderness risk, freeze/spell requirements and chosen team/solo method. A powered staff does not substitute for a required freezing spell.
Preserve combat versus temple/pyre-building roles, supplies, keys and utility tools. Do not merge all subactivities into a single combat preset.
Preserve tortugan-shield protection and the source's worn-weight threshold where that method is selected. Total carried weight does not establish adequate equipped weight.
Keep an approved icy-breath shield or the exact verified safespot method. Do not substitute an ordinary anti-dragon shield or unrelated defender.
Keep demonbane/main method and altar-related utility. Preserve task-dependent Slayer eligibility; do not import undead-only Salve choices.
Keep Slayer eligibility, prayer sustain and task-specific headgear. Lower owned melee alternatives should follow the selected style and sustain method.
Keep Karuulm floor protection/diary waiver, task status, the chosen attack style and any guide protection assumptions.
Keep icy-breath protection and task/species context. Share the verified shield rule with the boss/activity entry without losing its Slayer-specific conditions.
Keep smoke protection and the selected barrage/cannon method, including spell/runic supply requirements. Protecting only the head slot is not a complete loadout validator.
Keep crush-oriented Wilderness method, risk, poison and utility requirements. Use lower owned crush choices instead of a generic melee weapon ladder.
Keep axe, food, anti-poison and transport/mushroom utility according to the method. Combat equipment is secondary and must not displace required tools.
Keep harpoon type, toolbelt/utility availability, buckets/ropes and chosen method. Do not add ordinary combat gear to intentionally empty slots.
Treat equipment and supplies as created inside the minigame; ordinary bank ownership is not an appropriate readiness test. Separate normal/corrupted and recipe examples.
Keep crush and tail-specific weapon behaviour, team method and relevant prayer/supply assumptions. Main-body rankings do not automatically rank tail choices.
Keep ranged weapon/ammo and the required shadow-spell utility. A generic magic main-hand or unrelated rune set is not a substitute for that utility role.
Keep the selected magic or melee method and method-matched inventory. Review changed equipment columns before refreshing rankings.
Keep group-role, crush-main and magic-pillar equipment separate. Do not use the solo Phosani inventory merely because items overlap.
Preserve magic method, freezing/spellbook needs, attack range and relevant utility. Staff families differ in supported spells and range.
Keep room and role distinctions, melee/ranged/magic switches and unique encounter tools. Group/role-specific alternatives are not a universal list.
Require smoke protection and separate melee, blood-healing and freezing/safespot methods. Bloodbark and staff-range effects can matter more than a generic magic rank.
Preserve watering cans, outfit, run-energy and chosen planting method. No combat completion.
Keep invocation, room, salt/max-hit and inventory-space assumptions local to ToA. A mage helm switch may intentionally be omitted; its table must not provide universal fallbacks.
Remap the newly changed table structure. Keep shield-up switches and shield-down heavy/crush options separate, with demonbane and ammunition requirements.
Preserve role, tools, water/container and travel requirements. Do not import unrelated skilling or combat inventory examples.
Keep ranged/magic method, ammo and sustain priorities. Slayer-task headgear and full-set alternatives need explicit eligibility.
Preserve knife, log/bow/material state and chosen fletching method. Unstrung bows are materials, not combat fallback weapons; price-dependent templates need fresh provenance.
Keep slash-oriented choices, encounter-dependent weapon performance and sustain. Generic stab/crush or static target-DPS rankings are insufficient.
Keep crush-oriented Wilderness method, risk, poison and escape/support roles. Preserve solo/group distinctions and charge state.
Keep crush, undead/demon interactions and Wilderness risk. Evaluate Salve versus Slayer assumptions correctly rather than stacking them.

Keep the selected dragonfire package, Salve/headgear compatibility, ammunition and crumble-undead capability. Review changed ranged weapon columns; a shield substitution depends on the whole protection package.
Keep a weapon that can damage vyres, the area's prayer/sustain method and transport. An ordinary higher-tier melee weapon is not an acceptable fallback.
Preserve warmth and skilling utility counts, food/HP context and the selected method. A generic item-stat ranking cannot replace warmth validation.
Keep pickaxe and skilling/protection utility. Defensive shield order is activity-specific, not a generic combat off-hand ranking.
Keep ranged/magic switches, venom protection, spell/ammo state and selected method. Mystic is already a listed lower option in parts of this guide and should retain its true rank.
